title: Integral reduction after restriction is a derived tensor functor
statement: Fix a prime ℓ and a normed field E with a normed ℚ_ℓ-algebra structure, and the coefficient objects of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients]. On every scheme T let φ_T be its integral-to-residue coefficient map and B_T the regular residue module restricted along φ_T. The functor integralReduction ℓ E T followed by exact derived restriction along φ_T admits a counit from the homotopy-category localization which makes it a total left derived functor of ordinary tensoring with B_T. The tensor is the relative tensor on internal integral module objects. This asserts the universal property for the specified derived extension functor, not only a comparison after forgetting scalar actions.

source.place: Lemma 6.5.9(3), tensor interpretation of coefficient change; coequalizer and K-flat universal-property argument

proof.text: Use Mod.extendForgetTensorObjIso for the two coequalizer presentations. To verify integral linearity, precompose with R tensor extendπ, which is an epimorphism. The extension and relative-tensor balancing equations reduce both sides to the same multiplication composite; associator naturality proves equality. Lift the underlying isomorphisms by Mod.isoMk. Faithfulness of Mod.forget detects the naturality equation supplied by Mod.extendForgetTensorIso.

Construct the counit for derived extension followed by exact restriction: whisker the extension counit by derived restriction, use mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh, then mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso. Compose with the homotopy image of the preceding tensor isomorphism.

Tensor with a fixed module preserves quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes. Use the proved acyclic_tensorRight_of_kFlat theorem and the braiding, then Functor.PreservesKFlatQuasiIso.mk'. On a K-flat complex, the constructed counit is a composite of the invertible extension counit and isomorphisms. Apply isLeftDerivedFunctor_iff_isIso_app_of_kFlat. This gives exactly the universal property in the statement, with no flatness assumption on the residue coefficient itself.

lean.statement:
theorem integralReduction_restrictTensor (T : Scheme.{u}) :
    ∃ ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ (integralReduction ℓ E T ⋙
          (Mod.comap (coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) T)).mapDerivedCategory) ⟶
        Functor.mapHomotopyCategory
          (tensorLeft ((Mod.comap (coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) T)).obj
            (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj
              (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (integralResidue ℓ E)) T)))) (.up ℤ) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Qh,
      Functor.IsLeftDerivedFunctor
        (integralReduction ℓ E T ⋙
          (Mod.comap (coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) T)).mapDerivedCategory)
        ε (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
          (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) Ab.{u + 1})
            (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) T)) (.up ℤ))
